game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Throne Hall, the throne hall of the kingdom: the knight must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Constant Guardian: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the signal beacon.
theme: The Kingdom – Throne Hall: the throne hall of the kingdom
core_gameplay_loop: In Throne Hall, repeat each round: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the signal beacon. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the energy value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the signal beacon using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The signal beacon reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the signal beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 3 (intro tier): Constant Guardian
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Constant Guardian' (Week 1 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Throne Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Throne Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The signal beacon reached with actions_used <= 19.
